name: with_empty_scope_is_local
template: {% with %}{% set x=1 %}{{x}}{% endwith %}{{x is undefined}}

name: with_nested_scope_restoration
template: {% set a=8 %}{% with a=1 %}{% with a=2,b=a %}{{a}}{{b}}{% endwith %}{{a}}{% endwith %}{{a}}

name: with_loop_name_shadowing
template: {% for i in [1] %}{% with i=2,loop=3 %}{{i}}{{loop}}{% endwith %}{{i}}{% endfor %}

name: with_namespace_shared_identity
template: {% set ns=namespace(x=1) %}{% with alias=ns %}{% set alias.x=2 %}{% endwith %}{{ns.x}}

name: with_capture_autoescape_safety
template: {% autoescape true %}{% with a='<'|safe,b='>' %}{% set text %}{{a}}{{b}}{% endset %}{{text}}{% endwith %}{% endautoescape %}
